reconciled_ownership_decisions.security_TokenStore_kt: Moves to app/src/cloudPilot/java/com/weback/robot/security/TokenStore.kt (100% cloud/session-owned; zero offline/local references). TokenStore, TokenSaveResult, TokenLoadResult, and TokenClearResult are all covered in CLOUD_PILOT_DEX_RULES.
reconciled_ownership_decisions.MainActivity_PilotUiWorkflow: Private enum controlling PilotReadinessSheet moves out of MainActivity.kt into app/src/cloudPilot/ (inside PilotCapabilityBridgeImpl / ui/pilot/) so shared MainActivity holds zero pilot UI workflow state.
reconciled_ownership_decisions.AppContainerDependency_and_R1_seams: AppContainerDependency enum (zero cloud imports) remains in shared AppContainer.kt; OfflineAppContainer exposes robotTransportProvider, localStreamSourceProvider, and dependencyResolutionObserver; DefaultPilotContainer retains all 5 provider seams + dependencyResolutionObserver in src/cloudPilot/.
reconciled_ownership_decisions.BootSessionTimeProvider_kt: Remains in shared src/main/core/BootSessionTimeProvider.kt per design.md §1.1 (zero cloud/OkHttp/Keystore dependencies; wraps SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()).

declarations.rationale: Decoupled in L04A to delegate optional Pilot UI/resume lifecycle strictly through app.container.pilotCapabilityBridge (null in local/release).
Private UI workflow enum (MOCK/LIVE) solely controlling PilotReadinessSheet; relocated into src/cloudPilot/ with PilotCapabilityBridgeImpl in L04A so MainActivity has zero Pilot UI coupling.
